caption: The drawing depicts a single straw hat prominently centered on a plain, off-white background. The hat is light brown in color, illustrated with visible woven straw texture, and has a medium-high, rounded crown and a wide brim. Around the base of the crown, there is a cord or thin ribbon tied in a bow, with a long tassel hanging down to the right side. Above and to the right of the hat in the main drawing, there is a smaller, sketch-like inset labeled "Back View" that provides a simple outline view of the hat from the opposite side, including the visible cord and tassel details. The artist’s name, "Mary Humes," is lightly inscribed in the lower right corner of the paper. The composition is otherwise unadorned and minimal, focusing entirely on the hat and its details.
title: Boy's Hat
